Sourav Ganguly Appointed Delhi Capitals Head Coach for IPL 2027

Sourav Ganguly has been appointed as the head coach of the Delhi Capitals team for the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season. The appointment was announced on Tuesday. Ganguly, a former India captain, will be responsible for leading the team to a trophy in the 2027 season.
